newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Jochimsen slams Commission's EMU promotion.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Jochimsen slams Commission's EMU promotion.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Reimut Jochimsen on Monday attacked the European Union Commission for reportedly paying experts to play down the risks of monetary union in campaigns to inform the public about the planned single currency.

"If the EU Commission, as recently reported in the press, makes a whole series of secret arrangements with 170 scientists and high-ranking experts to talk down the risks under the pretext of giving objective information and in return for payment from EU funds, then -- I want to put it very mildly -- that is most definitely not the right way to solve the problem...," Jochimsen told a news conference.
Such a move was not suited to winning the confidence of citizens or of markets for the euro, Jochimsen said.
